plan.title: Plan your own trip
plan.description: We'll suggest an itinerary based on your days, budget and the pace you like.
plan.intro: For now we take itinerary requests by email and message. A self-serve planner is in the works, but while you wait this is faster — and you're talking to an actual person.
plan.step1Detail: How many days, who's coming, where you're starting from, roughly what budget, and whether you like it slow or packed.
plan.step2Detail: Within 2–3 days, with indicative costs and a few alternatives.
plan.step3Detail: Tell us what to cut and where you'd rather stay longer. We'll revise until it fits.
plan.step4Detail: We don't sell tours and we take no commission. You book it, you go, you decide.

about.title: About us
about.description: Our story — the two of us have been writing up our trips since 2021.
about.heading: Our story
about.lead: Chuyện Nhà Hưng is where the two of us keep our trips, so we can read them back later.
about.body1: It started with a trip to Đà Lạt at the end of 2021. We booked a sleeper bus two days ahead, booked no room at all, and it rained the entire time. As a piece of planning it was close to a failure, and it is still the trip we retell most.
about.body2: After that we started keeping notes: what it cost, where we stayed, which dishes were genuinely good, which stretches were not worth the ride. At first it was just for us, then friends asked so often that we put it here.
about.body3: We don't sell tours, we don't take sponsorship for write-ups, and we don't write about places we haven't been. If somewhere isn't worth the trip, we'll say so plainly.
about.value1Detail: Nothing aggregated from other people's posts. Every piece is a real trip, with a date on it.
about.value2Detail: If somewhere is crowded, overpriced, or not worth the journey, we say exactly that.
about.value3Detail: The numbers in our write-ups are what we paid, not the advertised price.
about.ctaLead: Read something new, browse an itinerary, or ask us to suggest a trip.
